description.en: Shows (or hides) a text bubble alongside the purpose marker set with CMND_BTL_SET_PURPOSE, formatted from a message-table text ID and optionally substituting a character's name into it.
True to show the purpose text, false to hide it.
Optional message-table text ID string (e.g. "purpose_021") to display.
Optional character ID string whose name is substituted into the text.
True once the purpose text has been updated; null if no visible argument was given.
